content: Release curation renames the drafted block to '## [X.Y.Z]' but must re-add the empty '## [Unreleased]' heading above it. scripts/version-bump.test.ts ('leaves the real CHANGELOG.md parseable') counts headings against the on-disk file and fails check:coverage without it.

name: release-bump-followups
description: Three local follow-ups after a version bump: regenerate prime goldens, keep README/ROADMAP prose STE-clean, run ext:install

Curating the release CHANGELOG must keep the standing empty '## [Unreleased]' heading above the new '## [X.Y.Z]' section. scripts/version-bump.test.ts ('leaves the real CHANGELOG.md parseable') counts release headings on the committed file and fails if the Unreleased heading was consumed by the curation. Hit during the v0.17.0 release.
resolution: Restore an empty '## [Unreleased]' heading directly above the new release section after curating the draft.

content: After 'bun run version:bump', run 'WARREN_UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 bun test src/cli/commands/prime.golden.test.ts' to regenerate src/cli/commands/__golden__/prime/, verify the diff shows only the version string change, and commit the fixtures with the release.

description: v0.18.0 release (run 32388036102) failed its GKE deploy three times on 'kubectl apply -k': a bursty GKE API server returned InternalError ('the server is currently unable to handle the request') on a different handful of resource GETs each pass, while the deployment itself had already been configured on attempt 2 (live /version was 0.18.0 with the draft release, npm, judge roll, promote and announce all missing). A whole-overlay retry needs one fully clean pass, which a bursty server may never give.
resolution: warren-5ca2: render once with 'kubectl kustomize -o DIR' and apply each resource on its own with a bounded per-resource retry (8 attempts, linear backoff), namespaces first; a resource that never converges is fatal after the rest applied.

name: release-draft-resume
description: A failed release chain leaves a draft release behind a pushed tag, and that state could not pick up a workflow fix: 'gh run rerun' replays the OLD workflow commit, and a fresh workflow_dispatch saw the tag and skipped the chain. release.yml's version-check now treats an existing DRAFT release as resumable (emits the peeled tag commit as release_sha; deploy + publish pin to it; FINAL releases still skip), so the recovery path is: land the workflow fix on main, then 'gh workflow run release.yml --ref main'. Workflow-step tests in scripts/release-hardening.test.ts and scripts/deploy-trigger.test.ts execute the real step scripts against stub git/gh/kubectl on PATH rather than string-matching the YAML.
